name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1494: The last Routine-I red was the dead-click sweep reporting calc tile 0 - Key of Hate - as clicking into the void. The sweep visits bosses before calc and Key of Hate is The Summoners signature drop, so that item was ALREADY the live selection when the sweep reached the tile; re-clicking the item you are already looking at cannot change state, and that is correct. The exemption is narrow - the target must be the live selection AND its detail on screen - and every dead-click report now carries the state signature from both sides of the click, because the first fix was a guess made without one.
